summary: Hourly tag reroute causing delayed reserve credit and invoice mismatch
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports a missing reserve (hourly buffer) credit on the finalized invoice for the billing window 2026-03-07 00:00 to 2026-03-07 01:00 UTC. The reserve credit was expected to offset a transient burst while their Dedicated fallback routed traffic to Hosted for ~15 minutes. Instead the invoice shows the burst usage billed with no reserve credit and an interim negative line item later that appears unrelated.

Impact:
- NovaCommerce incurred an unexpected charge of ~$1,200 on a finalized invoice for a one-hour window.
- Customer billing reconciliation flagged the missing reserve credit; finance has paused autopay pending resolution.

Environment:
- Production (us-east)
- Customer uses Dedicated capacity with Hosted fallback enabled
- Affected model variants: rw-open-7b-quant (dedicated), rw-embed-2.1 (hosted)

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) 2026-03-07T00:12 UTC - Dedicated pool reported transient saturation and triggered fallback routing policy to Hosted for ~15m.
2) During fallback, several large batch embed jobs (NovaCommerce batch job id: batch-8721) retried on client side producing duplicate postbacks to billing service within the retry window.
3) Postbacks from the Hosted backend for the window arrived out-of-order to the reconciler due to a reroute of hourly-metering tags (ref: routing-change 2026-03-07T00:10).
4) Reconciler applied an hourly tag for the fallback and queued credits; due to out-of-order arrival the reserve credit allocation job skipped the affected hourly bucket and later applied a negative adjustment to a different window.
5) Invoice finalized before the reconciler corrected the allocation, leaving the charge present on the invoice and a subsequent negative line that does not map cleanly to the expected reserve credit.

Expected behavior:
- Reserve (hourly buffer) credits should be applied to the exact hourly bucket where fallback consumption occurred, even if postbacks arrive out of order.
- Finalized invoices should reflect the corrected credit or show a clear provisional credit line for reconciliation.

Actual behavior:
- Reserve credit was not applied to the affected hour; invoice shows billed amount and a later negative adjustment that does not offset the invoice due to memoing to a different finalized billline.

Logs / artifacts attached:
- Reconciler logs (filtered) snippet: "reconciler:skip-allocation: bucket=2026-03-07T00:00 reason=tag-mismatch incoming_tag=hosted-fallback-hourly routed_tag=dedicated-hourly"
- Billing postback traces: trace ids: pb-20260307-00455, pb-20260307-00523
- Customer batch job id: batch-8721 (NovaCommerce internal id)

Investigation notes (initial):
- Correlated reconciler logs with postback traces and routing audit: there was a configuration push (scheduler/routing) at 2026-03-07T00:09 that changed the hourly-tag mapping for fallback windows.
- The reconciler assumes monotonic postback ordering for hourly allocation when tags change within the window; out-of-order delivery causes the allocation job to drop the tag-matching step and move on, leaving credits unallocated.
- Hypothesis: a combination of client retries (duplicate postbacks) + tag change + finalization timing created a race where the credit allocator skipped the bucket.
- Early workaround applied: manual allocation of reserve credit to the affected hourly bucket and generated a corrective invoice adjustment (provisional credit issued while finance reviews).

Next steps:
- SRE/Payments to add a guard in the reconciler to hold finalization on impacted hour when tag mappings change within a 10m window or when duplicate postbacks are detected.
- Engineering to backfill missing allocations for affected customers and reconcile invoices for finalized windows within the month.
- Communicate to NovaCommerce the workaround and ETA for a corrective invoice.
comments: Support - Aisha Patel (2026-03-10): Opened ticket after customer escalated to CS manager. Collected invoice pdf and customer batch job id. Requested billing traces and reconciler logs from Payments team.

Payments - Oliver Grant (2026-03-10): Retrieved postback traces and initial reconciler logs. Noted out-of-order postbacks and a scheduling change at 2026-03-07T00:09. Marking high priority due to finalized invoice and autopay hold.

Engineering - Marcus Chen (2026-03-11): Confirmed reconciler behavior: tag mapping changes within an hour can lead to allocation skips when combined with duplicate postbacks. Drafting a short-term reconciler patch to re-try allocation when a late postback matches an unallocated bucket.

Customer - Jane Miller (NovaCommerce) (2026-03-11): Customer accepts temporary manual credit but requests assurance final invoice will be corrected and that autopay will not be charged while investigation continues.

Support - Lina Rodriguez (2026-03-12): Applied manual provisional credit of $1,200 to NovaCommerce account and submitted invoice adjustment request to finance (ticket FIN-4281). Noted as temporary; awaiting permanent reconciler fix.
resolution: Workaround applied: provisional credit of $1,200 issued and corrective invoice adjustment initiated. Engineering to deploy reconciler guard for tag-change windows; backfill plan scheduled. Finance to reconcile finalized invoice once backfill completes.
